boot-guard/launcher.title: The boot guard did not run
boot-guard/launcher.why: This service is configured to roll back a Crow update that keeps crashing on startup (CROW_BOOT_GUARD=1), but the part that runs before every start did not run. Nothing else is affected — but a bad update cannot be rolled back automatically, so it would keep restarting. Re-run the boot-guard install step for this service (scripts/ops/install-boot-guard.sh), then restart it.

Re-run the boot-guard install step for this service (scripts/ops/install-boot-guard.sh), then restart it.

browser-image-stale/no-version.title: The browser add-on is still running the old version
browser-image-stale/no-version.why: Crow updated the browser add-on, but the copy that is running is still the old one. Restart it to load the update. A restart cannot be undone, and the pages that are open in the browser now will close. Saved logins and cookies are kept.

browser-image-stale/version-known.title: The browser add-on is still running the old version
browser-image-stale/version-known.why: Crow updated the browser add-on, but the copy that is running is still the old one. Restart it to load the update. A restart cannot be undone, and the pages that are open in the browser now will close. Saved logins and cookies are kept. Running now: version 1.9.2. The update would install version 1.9.4.

browser-image-stale/version-unknown.title: The browser add-on is still running the old version
browser-image-stale/version-unknown.why: Crow updated the browser add-on, but the copy that is running is still the old one. Restart it to load the update. A restart cannot be undone, and the pages that are open in the browser now will close. Saved logins and cookies are kept. Running now: an earlier version that does not report its number. The update would install version 1.9.4.

bundle-bind-drift/bind-extra.title: Restart Audiobookshelf to apply its updated network settings
bundle-bind-drift/bind-extra.why: Audiobookshelf is still reachable on 0.0.0.0:9000 from other devices, but its settings no longer publish that port. Restart it on the Extensions page to apply them.

bundle-bind-drift/bind-wider.title: Restart Audiobookshelf to apply its updated network settings
bundle-bind-drift/bind-wider.why: Audiobookshelf is still reachable on 0.0.0.0:13378 from other devices, but its settings now keep it on this computer only. Restart it on the Extensions page to apply them.

bundle-compose-edited.title: Changedetection.io's compose file has local changes
bundle-compose-edited.why: Changedetection.io's compose file has local changes, so Crow did not update it. Move your changes into docker-compose.override.yml and restore the compose file (a copy of the current one is kept as docker-compose.yml.bak when Crow restores it).

bundle-compose-image-change/added.title: Vikunja's settings file has an update Crow did not apply
bundle-compose-image-change/added.why: Crow keeps Vikunja on its current settings because the update would also add a helper step "vikunja-volume-owner" that uses the image "busybox:1.38.0@sha256:a46257e0". Back up its data, then press 'Apply the update' to switch, or keep it as it is.

bundle-compose-image-change/removed.title: Vikunja's settings file has an update Crow did not apply
bundle-compose-image-change/removed.why: Crow keeps Vikunja on its current settings because the update would also remove the step "web-legacy-helper". Back up its data, then press 'Apply the update' to switch, or keep it as it is.

bundle-compose-image-change/swapped.title: Vikunja's settings file has an update Crow did not apply
bundle-compose-image-change/swapped.why: Crow keeps Vikunja on its current settings because the update would also change its image (vikunja/vikunja:0.24.6 → vikunja/vikunja:0.25.1; it may be older than what is running). The update also tightens how Vikunja is published. Back up its data, then press 'Apply the update' to switch, or keep it as it is.

bundle-compose-image-change/swapped-none.title: Vikunja's settings file has an update Crow did not apply
bundle-compose-image-change/swapped-none.why: Crow keeps Vikunja on its current settings because the update would also change its image (none → none; it may be older than what is running). The update also tightens how Vikunja is published. Back up its data, then press 'Apply the update' to switch, or keep it as it is.

bundle-compose-needs-config.title: Vikunja's settings file was not updated
bundle-compose-needs-config.why: Crow could not update Vikunja's settings file: it needs VIKUNJA_DB_PASSWORD set first (Configure on its Extensions card).

bundle-repo-bind-drift/edited.title: Audiobookshelf is still published to other devices
bundle-repo-bind-drift/edited.why: Audiobookshelf is published to other devices; Crow now ships it on this computer only. Restart won't change that while its compose file has local changes — see the other card.

bundle-repo-bind-drift/unknown.title: Audiobookshelf is still published to other devices
bundle-repo-bind-drift/unknown.why: Audiobookshelf is published to other devices; Crow now ships it on this computer only. Restart won't change that while Crow cannot tell whether the installed compose file has local changes.

caddy-admin-socket.title: This machine's Caddy admin API is open to any program on it
caddy-admin-socket.why: Caddy's admin API is on its default local address with no authentication, so any program or bot on this machine can rewrite the Caddy that fronts Crow. One command moves it onto a unix socket only Caddy's own service user can open. Crow does not run as root, so run this once on the server: sudo bash <checkout>/scripts/fix-caddy-admin-socket.sh

caddy-proxy-socket.title: Visitors coming in through this machine's Caddy are being turned away
caddy-proxy-socket.why: Caddy still hands them to the gateway over a loopback connection with its own forwarding header, which Crow cannot tell apart from any other program on this machine — so Crow's Nest refuses them. Pointing Caddy at the gateway's own proxy socket fixes it. Crow does not run as root, so run this once on the server: sudo bash <checkout>/scripts/fix-caddy-proxy-socket.sh

data-backend-reapproval.title: Data backends need approving again
data-backend-reapproval.why: 3 data backend(s) were approved before Crow protected approvals with a key kept outside its database. They stay stopped until you approve them again on the Projects page.

remote-exposure/crow-sharing.title: Your Phone tried to use Sharing & Messages, but it isn't shared with this device yet
remote-exposure/crow-sharing.why: Allow it for Phone only — your other Crows stay unchanged, and the allowance can expire or be removed in Settings.
